article.title: Pangram發布Image 1.0，加入局部熱圖及影片逐格偵測
article.title_en: Pangram releases Image 1.0 with heatmaps and frame-level video detection
article.summary: 11月4日更新涵蓋圖像、影片及API，較低解像度輸入會附信心提示。
article.summary_en: The November 4 update covers images, video and API access, with confidence caveats for lower-resolution inputs.
highlights: 圖像最低尺寸降至256×256；低於512的結果附提示。
Image Flash 1.0可逐格分析上載影片。
highlights_en: Minimum image input falls to 256×256, with a caveat below 512.
Image Flash 1.0 can analyze uploaded video frame by frame.
article.why: 品牌審閱外來素材時，可多一項篩查線索，配合原檔、授權及供應商製作紀錄核對。
article.why_en: Brands gain another screening signal for incoming assets, alongside originals, licenses and production records.
article.next_step: 先以已知來源的真實及合成素材測試誤判；有爭議時由人手查原檔，不單靠分數拒稿。
article.next_step_en: Test false positives on known real and synthetic assets; inspect originals manually before rejecting disputed material.
article.detail: Pangram稱新模型可標示圖像中疑似AI區域，並透過瀏覽器擴充及API提供相關功能。公司同時公布自有及學術測試結果；本報沒有重做測試，因此不沿用其準確率作獨立結論。壓縮、修改及低解像度會影響審閱情境，偵測標記應視為進一步查證的起點。它不能單獨證明素材作者、授權是否有效，亦不能作為侵權或欺詐判定。
article.detail_en: Pangram describes localization of suspected AI regions and browser/API access. Its benchmark accuracy is not independently reproduced here. Detection should trigger further checking, especially on compressed or edited assets; it cannot establish authorship, license validity, infringement or fraud.
